_note_ssh: Use ssh_key_path for key-based auth (recommended). For password auth instead, remove ssh_key_path and add: 'ssh_password': 'yourpassword'
_note_token: Get the token value from Proxmox UI: Datacenter > Permissions > API Tokens > Add. See README for full steps.
_note_node: node_name is 'pve' by default. Check yours at the top-left of the Proxmox web UI.
